summary: Sequans Communications S.A. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent: current report on Form 8-K) disclosing completion of its Bitcoin treasury exit, selling the remaining 314 Bitcoin held as of June 30, 2026, following its May 2026 convertible-debt redemption. No price per coin, aggregate proceeds, premium, advisor, or board recommendation were disclosed. The company reports no debt outside government-financed R&D obligations and no crypto holdings, leaving a simplified capital structure. Watch for disclosed proceeds, any repurchases or reinvestment into the 5G eRedCap roadmap, and whether reported Q2 product-revenue growth and tripled backlog convert into cash flow.
